rows.response_text: Hob Nob is a restaurant located at 21 W Victoria St, Santa Barbara, CA, offering New American cuisine. It offers outdoor seating and take-out options, and is also suitable for groups. However, it does not provide WiFi or music. The restaurant does not have a parking garage, valet, or a lot but street parking is available. It has an overall rating of 3 stars. Reviews from customers reveal a mixed experience. Some customers appreciate the location and the food, mentioning the truffle Parmesan fries and calamari as notable dishes. However, there are complaints about slow service and some found the food to be mediocre. The general sentiment is that the restaurant offers a decent dining experience, but not spectacular enough to warrant a special visit.

{"address":"21 W Victoria St","attributes":{"Ambience":null,"BusinessParking":{"garage":false,"lot":false,"street":true,"valet":false,"validated":false},"Music":null,"OutdoorSeating":true,"RestaurantsGoodForGroups":true,"RestaurantsReservations":true,"RestaurantsTakeOut":true,"WiFi":null},"business_stars":3.0,"categories":"American (New), Restaurants","city":"Santa Barbara","hours":null,"name":"Hob Nob","review_info":[{"review_date":"2012-01-10 22:30:49","review_stars":2.0,"review_text":"Some girlfriends and I were SO excited to come here, and were pretty disappointed. The food was okay but not spectacular and the service was horrible. It's in a good location, but you're definitely paying for the posh ambiance when you come here."},{"review_date":"2011-03-13 19:04:30","review_stars":2.0,"review_text":"After driving for 3+ hours from San Diego late Friday night, all my boyfriend and I wanted was to get some quick food and drink. Maybe we were desperate but we decided to come to Hob Nob because we were parked outside of it. 

Our initial impression was that this place was kind of alright. It seemed spacious with a back dining area, front loungy area, and small bar. As we came in, some people were leaving and you could hear the waitress and bartender shout out "thanks for coming!" We thought this would be a start to a good experience.

We took a seat at the bar, kind of waited for a while, but the starvation kicked into place. By this point I was frantically looking around trying to get SOME waiter's attention. There was one standing right behind us talking to a guest that just walked in. -- ignored for another couple of minutes--. Finally came, took our order and came back with our drinks.

The food on the other hand.. took ... for..... e.... ver..... Despite this, we enjoyed the truffle Parmesan fries. Yes tasty indeed - but cmon forks would have been appreciated. Unfortunately I could no longer overlook the slow service. We received our water that we asked for after we had already half-way eaten the fries. I probably should have learned my lesson by now.. but nope - I was still hungry and ordered the calamari (I blame yelp for this one! pictures on the site were not how they appeared in real life!). The calamari took almost 30-40 minutes to bring out. To put this in persepective... there were probably max 8 other people at this establishment at the time. NOT really sure why it took so long. And when it **FINALLY** came out - well it wasn't hot and fresh as I expected and it was really poorly done - overcooked and the batter crumbled off the calamari. 

all in all
- slow ass service
- mediocre to okay food
- cool vibe but not enough to salvage feeling starved and thirsty

We kept our cool. Smiled and was courteous - after all we were too tired and hungry to really put up a hissy fit, but we'll never stop by here again i'm pretty sure."},{"review_date":"2011-02-15 18:14:59","review_stars":3.0,"review_text":"If you wandered in for a drink and stayed for some food, you'll do just fine. The calamari was particularly above average, and the ahi tuna nachos looked fantastic as they went by.

if you made a special trip to come here, you should maybe upgrade your Yelp skills. Service was well-meaning but not terrifically competent and the food was tasty, but about as interesting as you'd find at your average corporate hotel restaurant (though definitely better priced)."}],"state":"CA"}

We took a seat at the bar, kind of waited for a while, but the starvation kicked into place. By this point I was frantically looking around trying to get SOME waiter's attention. There was one standing right behind us talking to a guest that just walked in. -- ignored for another couple of minutes--. Finally came, took our order and came back with our drinks.

The food on the other hand.. took ... for..... e.... ver..... Despite this, we enjoyed the truffle Parmesan fries. Yes tasty indeed - but cmon forks would have been appreciated. Unfortunately I could no longer overlook the slow service. We received our water that we asked for after we had already half-way eaten the fries. I probably should have learned my lesson by now.. but nope - I was still hungry and ordered the calamari (I blame yelp for this one! pictures on the site were not how they appeared in real life!).
